privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains a participant 'sub-99' who must be excluded from the group means; they have a constant RT of 600ms (zero variance). The CSV columns are: participant_id, block, trial, number, parity, response_hand, correct, and rt_ms. The SNARC slope is the unstandardized beta from regressing (mean_RT_Right - mean_RT_Left) on the number magnitude (1-9). Accuracy must be calculated using all trials from blocks 2 and 3 before any RT-based filtering.
